scientific.integrity: The lower bound uses the standard twin indistinguishability argument; sufficiency is proved by an explicit distance-difference case analysis. The polynomial is then an exact product count over independent blade choices and the optional center.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is restricted to \(k\ge2\) and \(m\ge2\); the bladewise criterion fails at both excluded boundaries. Exhaustive computation covers only small parameters and is used as a regression check, while the general result rests on the analytic proof. Literature search cannot exclude every unindexed source.

title: Doubly resolving sets of generalized windmill graphs factor blade by blade
